functions.name: padEnd
functions.summary: Pads the current string with a given string (possibly repeated) so that the resulting string reaches a given length. The padding is applied from the end (right) of the current string.

params.name: maxLength
params.description: The length of the resulting string once the current string has been padded. If this parameter is smaller than the current string's length, the current string will be returned as it is.

params.name: fillString
params.description: The string to pad the current string with. If this string is too long, it will be truncated and the left-most part will be applied. The default value for this parameter is " " (U+0020).

returns.description: The string padded at the end to maxLength.

functions.name: padStart
functions.summary: Pads the current string with a given string (possibly repeated) so that the resulting string reaches a given length. The padding is applied from the start (left) of the current string.

params.name: maxLength
params.description: The length of the resulting string once the current string has been padded. If this parameter is smaller than the current string's length, the current string will be returned as it is.

params.name: fillString
params.description: The string to pad the current string with. If this string is too long, it will be truncated and the left-most part will be applied. The default value for this parameter is " " (U+0020).

returns.description: The string padded at the start to maxLength.
